caption: The drawing depicts a wooden side table with an oval-shaped top and fluted cylindrical legs. The table has a reddish-brown wood finish, with the main body and legs displaying visible vertical grain and ribbed details. The table features one shallow drawer at the top, indicated by two round brass-colored knobs and a central keyhole. Below the drawer is a set of cabinet doors, also with vertical ribbing, one of which includes a small keyhole and visible brass hinges. Each of the four legs is tapered, fluted, and finished with small brass casters at the bottom, allowing for mobility. The background is plain with a beige or off-white color and does not include any other objects or additional ornamentation.
title: Sewing Table
